title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | K-IG 교육 ENGLISH | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육- 242]

blocks.text: I have many dreams for the future.
However, my dream job is to become an interpreter.
There are many reasons I want to become an interpreter.
First, I like learning other languages,
and learning English is very exciting for me.
Second, English is the most widely used language in the world,
so I know that English is an important to build good international
Another reason is that I want to translate many interesting books
so that many Koreans can truly enjoy many fun
Furthermore, I want to interpret for people who can’t speak English,
so that they can know what is going on in the world around them.
